title: No horizontal overflow on desktop (1536px)
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Compare document.documentElement.scrollWidth with the viewport width
expected_result: scrollWidth does not exceed the viewport width; there is no horizontal scrollbar and no section is cut off.

title: Section order is the same on desktop, tablet and mobile
test_data: Expected order: hero, Who We Are, Design Leadership, What We Make, What Sets Us Apart?, Environmental Values, CTA, footer
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Scroll slowly from top to bottom so every section is revealed (some sections are hidden until scrolled into view)
Note the order of the sections
Repeat at 768x1024 and 1536x864
expected_result: Sections appear in the listed order at all three viewport widths; none is missing or duplicated.

title: Images are not broken at mobile width
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)

Check every img element on the page (complete = true, naturalWidth > 0), including lazy-loaded ones
expected_result: All visible images load; none overflows its container or is distorted beyond its aspect ratio.

Look at the hero block

title: Layout switches when the window is resized from desktop to mobile
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Confirm the desktop nav links are visible
Resize the window to 375x812 without reloading
Look at the header and the page layout
expected_result: The header switches to the mobile layout (search icon and hamburger instead of the nav links) and content reflows without horizontal overflow.
